    Changelog

    Source: NEWS.md

    hexmakR 0.3.0

    • Start the default designer with a fresh logo. Add, duplicate, remove and edit individual parts; browse the archive separately and explicitly reuse selected components or whole motifs without replacing the current project.
    • Select and drag visible items, use short labels, organise Frame/Icon/Name or custom groups, and move groups together. Rotate individual parts.
    • Import PNG/JPEG figures as embedded image parts and supported SVG artwork as independently editable vector components. Support local SVG references and redundant convex clips; reject active content and unsupported features.
    • Preserve added parts, uploaded artwork, labels, groups and edits in portable JSON projects and R recipes, with a 20 MiB save/load limit and data-only validation. Uploads are limited to 10 MiB. Older v5 projects retain their archive behaviour.
    • Keep artwork clipping aligned with edited frame geometry and preserve source appearance when copying archive components.
    • Standardize the named v5 package logo across README, every vignette and documentation page with matching light/dark artwork. Keep the application title as plain hexmakR text and label its archive tab CTTIR Gallery.

    hexmakR 0.2.0

    • Add the complete CTTIR v5 library: 45 native R vector identities and 1,035 unchanged original assets. Named designs place the package name inside.
    • Add hexagonal, pentagonal and square project logos with logo_design(); reuse CTTIR motifs or any of the 46 generic icons.
    • Add a default v5 editor with palette/layout controls, individual shape and coordinate editing, highlighting, undo/reset, JSON projects and R recipes.
    • Add catalogue/asset lookup, editable design objects, layer inspection, PNG/SVG/PDF export and complete catalogue regeneration.
    • Render name glyphs from the bundled JetBrains Mono font without requiring font installation. Preserve transparent exteriors and vector geometry.
    • Preserve the classic API/designer and record the twelve legacy-only names.

    hexmakR 0.1.0

    • Initial release
    • 19 curated color themes with dark and light variants
    • 46 built-in icons across 7 categories (science, biology, data/stats, medical, tech/code, shapes, fun)
    • Custom image upload support (PNG, JPG, SVG)
    • 13 font options with bold/italic toggles
    • Interactive Shiny app for visual sticker design
    • Programmatic API for scripted/batch sticker creation
    • Export to transparent PNG at configurable resolution
    • Full roxygen2 documentation and 3 vignettes
